title: Shareekatul Hussain Ummul Masaeb
body:
NANA KO BHI ROYI TO KABHI MAA KA MILA GHUM.
YEH GHUM HI BOHOT THA KE KIYA BAAP KA MATAM.
DEKHA HAI KABHI TUKDE JIGAR BHAYI HASSAN ASWS. KA.
ZAINAB ASWS...*4.
SHAREEKATUL HUSSAIN S.A...,, UMMUL MASAAYEB S.A....,, SAANI E ZEHRA S.A...
1. HAR GHAM SE SIWA HAI TERA GHAM QWAAHAR E SARWAR S.A.
KYA KYA NA HUE TUJHPE SITAM QWAAHAR E SARWAR S.A...**2.
TAA ZEEST UTHATI RAHI HAR GAAM PE EEZA...
<<MINI>>
ZAIINAABBB S.A........*4.
<<DIVIDER>>
2. IS TARHA KOI DEEN PE QURBAA'N NAHI BIBI.
DUNIYA ME TERE JAISI KOI MAA NAHI BIBI...**2.
BETO KE BHI LAASHO'N PE KIYA SHUKR KA SAJDA.
<<MINI>>
ZAAIINAAABB S.A.......*4.
<<DIVIDER>>
3. VEERA'N HUA AASHOOR KO TAA ASR BHARA GHAR. AUR SAAMNE AANKHO'N KE WO CHALTA HUA QANJAR..*2.
BHAAYI KA GALA DASHT MEIN KAT-TE HUE DEKHA.
<<MINI>>
ZAIINAABBB S.A.........*4
<<DIVIDER>>
4. NAIZO'N KI BULANDI PA SHAHEEDO'N KE SAR AAYE.
AADA L.A. NE NABI ZADIYO'N KE QAIME JALAYE..**2.
CHADAR JO GAYI SAR SE TADAPNE LAGI DUKHIYA..
<<MINI>>
ZAAIINAAABB S.A........*4
<<DIVIDER>>
5. PHIR KARKE ASEER AALE PAYAMBAR SAWW. KO SITAMGAR L.A.
RULWAATE RAHE DHOOP MEIN KAANTO'N PE CHALAAKAR..**2.
TAY KARTI RAHI KUFE KA AUR SHAAM KA RASTA.
<<MINI>>
ZAAIINAAABB S.A.......*4.
<<DIVIDER>>
6. ALLAH JJH. RE DARBAR E YAZEEDI L.A. KA WO MANZAR.
THE KURSI NASHEE'N SAAT SAU(700) SHAHZADI S.A. KHULE SAR..**2.
AUR TASHT MEIN ROTA THA SARE DILBAR E ZEHRA S.A.
<<MINI>>
ZAAIINAAABB S.A........*4
<<DIVIDER>>
7. ZINDAA'N MEIN HUI BAALI SAKINA S.A. SE JUDAAYI.
PUR DARD MILI AALE MUHAMMAD SAWW. KO REHAAYI..**2.
MAJLIS KI BINA DAAL KE KARNE LAGI GIRYA..
<<MINI>>
ZAAIINAAABB S.A.....*4..
<<DIVIDER>>
SHAREEKATUL HUSSAIN S.A.,, UMMUL MASAAYEB S.A.,, SANI E ZEHRA S.A.
Kalaam: JANAB MOHSIN KAMAAL SAHAB QIBLA.
